## User Outcome

Describe the concrete user or contributor improvement.

## Scope

List the files or behavior in scope. State what is intentionally out of scope.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The observable behavior is defined.
- [ ] The relevant deterministic check is identified.
- [ ] A real-Copilot integration check is identified if behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation impact is identified.

## Guidance

Link to relevant source, tests, or contribution documentation. Do not include
credentials, private prompts, or generated JSON edits.
